department: Environmental Sciences (College of Sciences and Humanities)

deadline.value: International students should submit application materials by January 1 for assistantship consideration; other applicants by February 1.
deadline.quote: all application materials should be submitted by February 1 for the following academic year, and by January 1 if you are an international student.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants are asked to name a faculty mentor who will chair their PhD committee when applying; the page does not say the mentor must agree beforehand.
supervisor.quote: When you apply, we ask that you identify a faculty mentor who will chair your PhD committee.

funding.value: Graduate assistantships (teaching and research) are awarded to top students based on academic performance and cover partial tuition plus a stipend.
funding.quote: Our graduate assistantships, awarded to top students based on academic performance

also.quote: a partial tuition remission (some fees still apply) | a stipend during the academic year

entry_route.value: A master's degree in a relevant science is required before applying.
entry_route.quote: you must have the minimum of a master's degree in biology, chemistry, geography (meteorology, remote sensing, GIS), geological sciences, natural resources, environmental science, or an equivalent science program at an accredited institution

notes: Concentrations include biology, chemistry, geography, geological sciences and natural resources, all inside this one PhD. Program name: PhD in Environmental Sciences (Ball State lists it as PhD in Environmental Science in some places).
name: PhD in Environmental Sciences
